evals.expected_output: Fetches upstream main, fast-forwards local main with --ff-only, pushes to origin, reports SHAs.
assertions: Uses git merge --ff-only, not a merge commit.

evals.prompt: /ffmain, and tracked files have uncommitted edits.
evals.expected_output: Stops. Prints git status. Does not fetch, merge, stash, or push.

evals.prompt: /ffmain in a repo that only has origin. Origin is a GitHub fork with a parent.
evals.expected_output: Looks up the parent, adds it as upstream, then fetch, ff-only, push.
assertions: Adds an upstream remote from the host's parent record.
Does not stop only to tell the user to add upstream.

evals.prompt: /ffmain in a repo that only has origin. Origin is not a fork and has no parent.
evals.expected_output: Stops. Does not invent a parent. Does not add a guessed remote.
assertions: Does not git remote add a guessed URL.
Says origin has no parent, or that it could not find one.

evals.prompt: /ffmain, but local main has a commit upstream does not have.
evals.expected_output: Fetch happens. merge --ff-only fails. Stops. Does not rebase, reset, or force-push.

evals.prompt: /ffmain while on a clean feature branch.
evals.expected_output: Checks out main, fast-forwards, pushes, checks out the feature branch again.
assertions: Leaves the user on the branch they started on.

evals.prompt: Merge my feature branch into main and push.
evals.expected_output: This is not ffmain. Does not merge a feature branch.
assertions: Does not merge the feature branch.
Does not treat this as /ffmain unless they asked to fast-forward from upstream.

evals.prompt: /ffmain. Local fast-forward works. Origin rejects the push as non-fast-forward.
evals.expected_output: Stops with git's push output. Does not retry with force flags.
assertions: Does not retry the push with --force or --force-with-lease.
